name: g66_kings_status_pass
purpose: King's Shield against a Status move (decision 0040, checkMoveBypassesProtect with blockStatus false): Incineroar's Will-O-Wisp passes the shield and burns Aegislash (no -activate, no drop). Turn 2 King's Shield is up again; the same Will-O-Wisp is refused by the burn, since Aegislash already has a status. Intimidate on the switch-in is part of the same battle.
